economy.en:
U.S. jobs data disappointed with only 57,000 new payrolls in June, while the unemployment rate fell to 4.2%, sparking a mixed market reaction—the Dow hit a record close but the Nasdaq slid on chip weakness. ECB President Lagarde defended rate hikes amid recession fears, and China’s AI stock rally faces bubble concerns. Sportswear sales slumped in China despite the World Cup, and Hong Kong’s IPO pipeline is clogged. The major Chinese trading app 同花顺 suffered a morning outage that went viral.

- U.S. job creation missed expectations by nearly 50%, with downward revisions to prior months. The drop in unemployment was attributed to workers leaving the labor force, pushing participation to a 50-year low (ex-Covid). [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/02/jobs-report-june-2026-.html)
- Nvidia launched a program allowing startups to exchange equity for access to compute power, a novel revenue-sharing model. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/02/nvidia-plans-to-offer-start-up-customers-access-to-revenue-sharing-deals.html)
- Tesla shares plunged 7% despite reporting strong Q2 deliveries, reflecting persistent consumer backlash and demand concerns. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/02/tesla-tsla-q2-2026-vehicle-delivery-production.html)
- ECB's Lagarde defended the recent rate hike, but analysts warn of repeating the 2011 mistake as inflation remains sticky. [Equiti](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimgFBVV95cUxQRGdlcG12OHRfMXJOc1hiZnF2Rmd6RWlPb0xaWjIyWi1jTEpadk9QSThGOGxfc2FfNzFYdWdad1h2RXhRWC14eUN6RjlCY0RPTGxWdEh2S2VQT1NjQkxvTEJ1ZWRyQTd4cjVSR0xXSFo2UVFkMG9TUlFCUDNmNVI0WHJyemFBYVluTVFMNDhvVWtEMzR0MUpGYUpB)
- China’s AI stocks surged 65% in H1, but short-seller Michael Burry flagged bubble risks, and US investors are turning bearish on the global AI trade. [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3359195/chinas-ai-stocks-surge-65-first-half-bubble-fears-begin-weigh-sentiment)
- Hong Kong sees a wave of IPOs but many mainland applicants face expiration; Chinese investment banks are overtaking global giants in underwriting. [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3359242/chinese-banks-surge-ahead-amid-hong-kongs-ipo-wave-challenging-global-giants), [IndexBox](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxNX3gxdXFlSkxrbFFHZUFNZ0NCUThfX1hGV1gwSjNGMFpKUTFadko3dDZoeW5sN0FETHgzX1RVNDlqdDVmUWx0dGNnOXBfdk81blNZcEVUdVljSEh3bEsweV9sS3hwNGQxUmd2SHg0enFLZnNLVnlZNEZuREdTVTRkcG83YTlNNUFObmZLMG5DZ052V1ZLeGtRQ0hZVUpQdw)
- 同花顺 app crashed on Friday morning, causing widespread disruption; service restored but cause under investigation. [Sina Finance](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxQRkJnX0tKajYtbkNiUGxhWmxNMWc3NFkxNWhBV0dnWTJFLTZfMUt4aUNJOXJwdEVtYXRCNHQtR0FVZlVIb0pkU1FGdkR0M2hrU0dUenNNeUROSzZtVTFrZzR1YmJ2TFdxaEJFMUc2RWxuZ19hS2txWlVZT2U5cFFZUk90NWhmb2NobWV6eENzb240ZVNZck9OVXo3NWwzeEk)
- Sportswear brands like Nike and Adidas saw in-store sales decline in China despite the World Cup, indicating weak consumer demand. [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3359176/sportswear-firms-fail-score-world-cup-amid-china-sales-slump)

**Watch next:** The impact of the weak U.S. jobs report on Fed policy expectations, further developments in China’s AI stock bubble, and whether Hong Kong’s gold clearing system launch next week will boost its financial hub status.

society.zh:
过去24小时，全球社会新闻格局由重大冲突与结构性变革共同塑造。俄罗斯对基辅发动了自战争爆发以来规模最大的导弹与无人机袭击，造成至少30人死亡，而乌克兰方面亦持续打击俄石油设施，战争烈度显著升级。与此同时，加拿大总理卡尼签署新的输油管道协议，旨在摆脱对美能源依赖；伊朗在霍尔木兹海峡发出警告，中东紧张局势一触即发。经济层面，韩国Kospi指数因AI需求担忧暴跌近8%，芯片股遭恐慌性抛售，波及全球市场。中国方面，国务院印发《教育发展“十五五”规划》，稳岗扩岗政策延续，而援刚果（金）医疗队启程、C909医疗机首次亮相中亚，体现中国在公共卫生领域的国际行动力。知乎社区则围绕AI商业化、营收下滑以及娱乐营销展开热议。以下是各子专栏详细解读。

- **基辅遭遇最猛烈空袭**：俄罗斯于7月2日凌晨发射大量弹道导弹、巡航导弹和无人机，导致基辅多处建筑倒塌，死亡人数从至少18人升至30人（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c4gyv05gk4do?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)、[NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/02/nx-s1-5878894/russia-attacks-ukraines-capital-killing-more-than-a-dozen-people)），为近几个月最致命袭击。乌克兰继续打击俄油设施，双方互有攻守。
- **加拿大开辟能源新通道**：总理卡尼与相关方达成管道建设协议，旨在扩大对美以外市场出口石油，应对特朗普关税战带来的经济胁迫（[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/7/3/canadas-carney-secures-deal-for-pipeline-to-expand-oil-exports-beyond-us?traffic_source=rss)）。
- **伊朗警告霍尔木兹海峡船舶**：伊朗军方威胁将禁止未经批准的航线，在美伊间接谈判出现“积极进展”的次日发出强硬信号（[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/7/3/iran-warns-ships-against-using-unapproved-routes-in-strait-of-hormuz?traffic_source=rss)）。
- **韩国股市暴跌**：Kospi指数跌破8000点，芯片股因市场对AI需求放缓的担忧而重挫（[Korea Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE1BbTdqS1duWEJ3Z0l3ck9faVJkUFk1RE9kWUJhdkNWcHgzVlowbUExamZWNU9qWnVBRTMwT21aM2dRTWRicmd1ZmJjdU9nRE1FMTJtV3l0bw)）。
- **中国发布教育“十五五”规划**：国务院印发新规划，明确未来五年教育发展方向，涉及基础教育、职业教育等（[证券时报](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXEFVX3lxTE1kSTNYVXA5b1hjZE8wZEczd0tJVVF3SlRNeF9VTldiZXBybFZoZzdxWmQwajVHSEQtZzBBWTBpS2hYQ0RIR0ZfZlR5S1ZaNXVwYWJWVDJ6WlJrVEta)）。
- **知乎营收下滑，押注AI商业化**：知乎2025年营收同比下跌23.6%，CEO周源表示将加速AI商业化探索（[财联社](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1BSGJZY202VWVwaHF6NTA3V3Z3MUZHVENZVHVIWmI4YW1BY3NRa2VpVkx0QVE2bUw5MXphSGJjQmpXa002OXN0YQ)）。

**后续观察**：俄罗斯对基辅的新一轮攻击可能改变西方对乌援助节奏；霍尔木兹海峡紧张局势若实质化将推高全球油价；韩国芯片股抛售是否传导至其他科技市场需关注；中国教育规划的具体落地措施及对就业影响值得跟踪。
society.en:
The past 24 hours have been dominated by a devastating Russian attack on Kyiv, a sharp sell-off in South Korean tech stocks, and significant policy moves in China and Canada. The conflict in Ukraine escalates with a massive drone and missile barrage hitting the capital, while global markets react to AI demand fears. Meanwhile, China advances its AI integration in healthcare and education, and Canada secures a pipeline deal to reduce US dependence. The domestic social agenda in China focuses on employment and disability services, while Zhihu's revenue decline signals shifts in the content platform landscape. Below are the key developments from each desk.

- **Massive Russian Attack on Kyiv:** Russia launched its largest attack on Kyiv in months, killing at least 30 people using a combination of ballistic and cruise missiles and drones ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c4gyv05gk4do?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/02/nx-s1-5878894/russia-attacks-ukraines-capital-killing-more-than-a-dozen-people)). The attack underscores the ongoing intensity of the war and its humanitarian toll.
- **Canada’s Pipeline Deal to Bypass US:** Prime Minister Carney secured a deal for a pipeline to export oil beyond the US, a direct response to Trump’s trade war and a move to reduce economic dependence ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/7/3/canadas-carney-secures-deal-for-pipeline-to-expand-oil-exports-beyond-us?traffic_source=rss)). This shifts North American energy dynamics.
- **Iran Warns Ships in Strait of Hormuz:** Iran’s military issued a threat against ships using unapproved routes, coming a day after Qatari mediation claimed 'positive progress' in US-Iran talks ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/7/3/iran-warns-ships-against-using-unapproved-routes-in-strat-of-hormuz?traffic_source=rss)). This adds volatility to global oil transit.
- **Kospi Plunges on AI Demand Fears:** South Korea’s Kospi fell below 8,000 as chip stocks sold off amid worries about a slowdown in AI demand ([Korea Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE1BbTdqS1duWEJ3Z0l3ck9faVJkUFk1RE9kWUJhdkNWcHgzVlowbUExamZWNU9qWnVBRTMwT21aM2dRTWRicmd1ZmJjdU9nRE1FMTJtV3l0bw)). This signals a potential correction in the global semiconductor cycle.
- **China’s AI Push in Healthcare and Education:** China is accelerating AI integration, with Medtronic advocating AI-driven health management ([21CAIJING](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxQZVNxSWRMTU1nVzlWekhXQUxuNGlEQm1qTlRWekR3N1VJajBrZlJneWZBXy1nazQtdERvX3FZV2NJWDVaV2RVdUNQYnJ2a3doSGVZM09CMFl2R1FpTjEzMHdyaUNXdDdtODk4QnJ4QlVCcUlRaFNrRWxUVk1ONXNMdHk4Q0pQNm02ZDlzdw)) and the State Council releasing the 15th Five-Year Plan for education ([Securities Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXEFVX3lxTE1kSTNYVXA5b1hjZE8wZEczd0tJVVF3SlRNeF9VTldiZXBybFZoZzdxWmQwajVHSEQtZzBBWTBpS2hYQ0RIR0ZfZlR5S1ZaNXVwYWJWVDJ6WlJrVEta)). These moves highlight Beijing's focus on tech-driven modernization.
- **Vatican Excommunicates Traditionalist Sect:** The Vatican declared the Society of Saint Pius X in schism, affecting about 600,000 followers ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c5yz95188jjo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)). This is a major internal church rupture.
- **Zhihu’s Revenue Decline and AI Pivot:** Zhihu reported a 23.6% revenue drop in 2025, with CEO Zhou Yuan accelerating AI commercialization ([Cailianshe](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1BSGJZY202VWVwaHF6NTA3V3Z3MUZHVENZVHVIWmI4YW1BY3NRa2VpVkx0QVE2bUw5MXphSGJjQmpXa002OXN0YQ)). This reflects pressures on content platforms and the rush to AI.

**Watch next:** The trajectory of South Korean chip stocks will be a bellwether for global AI sentiment. The Russian attack may trigger new Western sanctions, while China’s education and AI policies will shape its long-term competitiveness. The Canada pipeline deal could redefine North American energy trade.

military.zh:
今日军事板块呈现多线并进态势：俄乌战场进入‘机器速度’超限战阶段，乌克兰以无人机和远程打击重创俄罗斯能源与粮食命脉，而俄罗斯则对基辅发动大规模报复空袭；与此同时，欧洲安全格局因立陶宛拟废除核武器禁令而面临历史性转折。印太方向，中美军事博弈在南海与台海同步升温，中国新型万吨大驱首次出岛链、日本陆自首次派遣、美军在菲律宾基地脆弱性曝光，以及美国防部成立无人系统专管机构、F-15EX与‘幽灵蝙蝠’无人机联演，均指向未来高端冲突的无人化与智能化趋势。

- **俄乌战争进入消耗决战阶段**：乌克兰持续以无人机和导弹打击俄罗斯后方，导致俄境内加油站斗殴、高价汽油、收成受损，俄军则对基辅发动最大规模空袭，至少21人死亡。战争被视为[耐力竞赛](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxOVzdzOVJTcHZjdHI1YnRWTHRGRDZwRGdXRUVuOExkMTBRU0tfMU1hNDhheXBRdU5sdk5Wb1NhdFVKM3ZENHRHMFRnSGx2dGpBRUsyNjN0RTc4SEpWU1FGTWlqZGV6cDVseHFLTEVhcVFaWjJ4Um1qRk9mVHhCN0ZqUjllWEhrUkZoQ192LUgxR05UWWxGcm4tbEl6VG1ocloz)，《华尔街日报》分析称战争威胁到俄罗斯的大国地位。
- **欧洲安全格局剧变**：立陶宛议会政党同意[解除核武器和外国军事基地的宪法禁令](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/07/02/lithuania-moves-to-end-nuclear-weapon-ban-as-situation-getting-worse/)，标志着波罗的海国家因俄罗斯威胁而转向核威慑。同时，IISS报告确认俄罗斯“极有可能”通过对英国美军基地的无人机入侵，实施在欧洲的[无人机战役](https://www.twz.com/air/russia-highly-likely-behind-drone-incursions-over-u-s-bases-in-england-report-concludes)，并可能利用影子船发射无人机。
- **美军印太演习展示新作战概念**：在“勇敢之盾”演习中，B-2轰炸机首次以LRASM导弹击沉靶船，F-15EX与澳大利亚[“幽灵蝙蝠”无人机](https://www.twz.com/air/f-15ex-and-ghost-bat-team-up-over-pacific-during-valiant-shield)编队飞行，表明F-15EX将发展为无人僚机控制器。美国防部另设立无人与自主系统[直接报告投资组合经理](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/02/defense-department-memo-establishing-the-direct-reporting-portfolio-manager-for-unmanned-systems)，强化无人机主导权。
- **中国军力快速投射引关注**：3月入列的中国12,000吨驱逐舰，6月即现身日本近海，日方紧急[跟踪](https://news.google.)。美方外交官建议台湾建立[“蜂巢”无人机群](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVEFVX3lxTFBiT0FJaVRPRUtJQVpzMjhLVDNuczJmTjN6WDFOZTU3U1UwektrWGpEQzhPejhvaFlxakpHckwtNTlpQUFXMjR1ZVdTSkp6eWcwS2o1Sw)以威慑冲突。

**后续观察**：俄乌战争的“超限战”特征正被双方不断强化，乌克兰通过法院阻止俄占区小麦出口，形成法律战场；立陶宛核武器禁令的解除可能引发波罗的海多米诺效应；印太方向，美军加速无人化与分布式杀伤，中国则以新型舰艇常态化前出回应，台海风险持续积累。此外，美国海军AARGM-ER反辐射导弹虽已量产，但海军已开始寻求替代方案，反映装备迭代速度加快。
military.en:
The past 24 hours underscore a global security landscape defined by escalating drone warfare, a Ukrainian campaign of strategic attrition against Russian infrastructure, and intensifying great-power posturing in the Indo-Pacific. Russia is blamed for a coordinated drone campaign over European airbases, while Ukraine demonstrates that long-range strikes on fuel and harvest assets can trigger domestic panic in Russia. Simultaneously, the U.S.-led Valiant Shield exercise showcased new manned-unmanned teaming with the F-15EX and Ghost Bat, and a B-2 sank a target ship with an LRASM for the first time. In the Pacific, China’s newest 12,000-ton destroyer already operates off Japan, and a U.S. diplomat urged Taiwan to become a ‘hornet’s nest’ of drones. Lithuania moved to end its constitutional ban on nuclear weapons, signaling a profound shift in European security thinking. The Pentagon continues to struggle with weapons development timelines, while a major European missile contract signals growing demand for long-range strike capabilities.

- **Ukraine hits Russia where it hurts**: [Fistfights at the Pumps, Gas at Luxury Prices, and a Harvest at Risk](https://news.google.) — National Security Journal
- **Russia “highly likely” behind drone incursions over U.S. bases in England**: [IISS report](https://www.twz.com/air/russia-highly-likely-behind-drone-incursions-over-u-s-bases-in-england-report-concludes) — The War Zone
- **Lithuania moves to end nuclear weapon ban**: [Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/07/02/lithuania-moves-to-end-nuclear-weapon-ban-as-situation-getting-worse/)
- **Valiant Shield showcases B-2 LRASM strike and F-15EX/Ghost Bat teaming**: [Warrior Maven](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxNSVJlS1kzUG1xeEVWZG5jX3M1dFVXTTJKWmJGUE9rcFUtODRlS3c3aU5IUUlaQjNhSVl3MnlSYjJRdnJPanVoOVFQTzJteTd2bWNWU2tEbENQX05VaEJ4UmNVcFEtdHZtUTZreDJkanZaeWFxOEM0N3VtY0Z5Y2tvU0thYWJkLVhMZEE) and [The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/air/f-15ex-and-ghost-bat-team-up-over-pacific-during-valiant-shield)

- **Pentagon continues to struggle with key weapons development timelines**: [GAO report via Breaking Defense](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxNNVU1RjBTeGhCVFNrSGJ1Qk1hbEF4SnpGbFRSNi05dDVmNHJlTkxuU2FqT0R6VUFOYWdjdG1WSWZ4RXRnUUJkRFd6NXphT0x3Tjc3aUhnZXl4TXB6QW5WaVZwVm9PaW9odXNlallXUWJzZ2JhczFyMUY1ZXFjMFBlRHJ0cGhvOUdlNWEtNDJJNFVmcGZHR0F1ejUyWDM0Tms2R3o5ZGVJRWZGQTFKMmg0)
- **Kongsberg lands $400M+ contract for JSM anti-ship missiles**: [Defence Industry Europe](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizAFBVV95cUxPOG4xX0ZqeXI1WnF3MVZXRnEtSUhaQVZ1bDhEeVBVR19MNlI1ZWNnQmVFcVZDWDdHc1oza1ZLOHRybFB0OW5LZG85eENyTkJHcWE5bkNGN29NWkc2ZXZ6MXVhSjEyQkZfeVRadTNFZjZSRW9TM1EwajdQZDFGSV8yNFl0elhDUjRyMHE5S2JrcVhhd2RFaElNcWVsdnhLNnBwMGp3azVOUEV0c3BiYk5RLWtOVGU0X1FPMFl4eUR6WW9RVjNyaHBhMlZpUzc)

**Watch next**: The NATO summit in Ankara could redefine burden-sharing and legitimize Turkey’s regional ambitions, while Ukraine’s endurance contest deepens as winter approaches. The rapid deployment of China’s new destroyer and the push for Taiwan’s drone fleet signal that the Indo-Pacific is entering a more kinetic phase of deterrence.

tech.zh: 今日科技新闻呈现三大主线：AI行业进入‘成本与监管’密集调整期，电动车市场在政策突变与销量分化中加速洗牌，隐私与基础设施议题在HackNews社区持续发酵。值得关注的是，[特斯拉内部对员工AI支出设限](https://electrek.co/2026/07/02/tesla-caps-employee-ai-spending-200-week/)与[Zuckerberg承认AI代理进展慢于预期](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/02/mark-zuckerberg-tells-staff-that-ai-agents-havent-progressed-as-quickly-as-hed-hoped/)形成共振，暗示前沿AI公司正从‘烧钱扩张’转向‘成本管控’，而[Anthropic与三星洽谈定制芯片](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/02/anthropic-is-discussing-a-new-custom-chip-with-samsung/)则从供应链端加码。汽车领域，[特斯拉Q2交付增25%](https://www.theverge.com/transportation/957685/tesla-q2-2026-sales-production-delivery-report)与[BYD在澳洲逼近丰田](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxQWVUzQlI1dG9zVWYta29fLXpHbWlaamlpbjZQc3dZTUVhbm5JSWJzTDRJWWZDbGJDZERNWk5QS0NsLVE3akFiT2lNV1JpbW03Q0JTSmlnMkZIYVJ3QVNKb0hDLTRLMTRtclVXbm93WVBhZE1UZE9EQ000Y05nTnFZWUt3cTBtdkg4Mlh4YUU5RGJGQzhxbjJRTzZFR3lGdk5PeWxzMnB6Qk9Ec1RkR1QxcA)形成对比，但[Polestar因被美国禁售而打2.5万美元折扣](https://electrek.co/2026/07/02/polestar-4s-are-a-smoking-deal-at-25k-off-now-that-theyre-banned-in-the-us/)撕开了贸易保护主义的成本裂口。隐私方面，[弗吉尼亚州禁止销售地理定位数据](https://www.hunton.com/privacy-and-cybersecurity-law-blog/virginia-bans-sale-of-geolocation-data)与[EFF反对X公司豁免FTC隐私令](https://www.eff.org/deeplinks/2026/06/eff-and-allies-xs-ftc-petition-waive-privacy-violation-order-should-be-rejected)同步推进，标志着美国州级隐私立法加速。**后续观察**：AI行业的资本纪律化是否引发裁员或并购潮？电动车关税战下，美欧品牌能否守住本土市场？地理定位数据禁令是否会蔓延至更多州，并倒逼联邦立法？
tech.en:
Today's tech landscape is defined by a fierce privacy backlash, a sobering reality check on AI costs and progress, and a rapidly shifting EV market where policy and competition are reshaping the playing field. From Virginia's ban on geolocation data sales to the first criminal charges tied to Tesla's Full Self-Driving, and from Meta's quiet launch of an AI gaming app to Polestar's fire-sale discounts after a US ban, the stories highlight both regulatory pushback and the growing pains of innovation. Key themes include the unraveling of 'free market' myths in internet infrastructure, the containment of corporate AI spending, and the acceleration of affordable EV alternatives.

- **Privacy Emergency:** Virginia's landmark ban on geolocation data sales (628 HN points) and an EFF letter to the FTC over X's consent order signal a new wave of state-level privacy enforcement. Scott Aaronson's 'American Privacy Emergency' essay ties this to the Census Bureau's recent ban on noise infusion, warning of systemic surveillance risks. [Virginia ban](https://www.hunton.com/privacy-and-cybersecurity-law-blog/virginia-bans-sale-of-geolocation-data) | [EFF letter](https://www.eff.org/deeplinks/2026/06/eff-and-allies-xs-ftc-petition-waive-privacy-violation-order-should-be-rejected) | [Aaronson post](https://scottaaronson.blog/?p=9902)
- **AI Cost Crunch:** Tesla caps employee AI spending at $200/week except for Grok, while a TechCrunch analysis warns that AI is undermining net-zero pledges at Google and Amazon. Mark Zuckerberg admits AI agents 'haven't progressed as quickly as he'd hoped,' and Anthropic discusses custom chips with Samsung as the hardware race heats up. [Tesla caps](https://electrek.co/2026/07/02/tesla-caps-employee-ai-spending-200-week/) | [AI cost warning](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/02/a-warning-sign-about-ais-real-cost-courtesy-of-google-and-amazon/) | [Zuckerberg](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/02/mark-zuckerberg-tells-staff-that-ai-agents-havent-progressed-as-quickly-as-hed-hoped/)
- **EV Market Disruption:** Tesla's Q2 sales jumped 25% globally, with a record June in Australia, but a Texas driver faces manslaughter charges after a fatal FSD crash. BYD's Sealion 7 nearly overtakes the Toyota HiLux in Australia, while Polestar offers $25k discounts after a US Commerce Department ban. Subaru's 375-hp Trailseeker EV starts under $40k. [Tesla Q2](https://www.theverge.com/transportation/957685/tesla-q2-2026-sales-production-delivery-report) | [Manslaughter charges](https://www.theverge.com/transportation/961161/tesla-fsd-katy-tx-manslaughter-charges) | [Polestar discounts](https://electrek.co/2026/07/02/polestar-4s-are-a-smoking-deal-at-25k-off-now-that-theyre-banned-in-the-us/) | [Subaru Trailseeker](https://electrek.co/2026/07/02/subarus-375-hp-awd-trailseeker-ev-starts-under-40000/)
- **Tech M&A and AI Consolidation:** SpaceX's acquisition of Cursor raises questions about platform neutrality, as Cursor hopes to keep offering third-party AI models. Meanwhile, a Nobel-winning DeepMind scientist defects to Anthropic, which just received Trump's blessing to go global. [Cursor/SpaceX](https://www.wired.com/story/can-cursor-remain-an-open-platform-inside-of-spacex/) | [DeepMind defection](https://news.google.)
- **Infrastructure and Energy Storage:** Iberdrola begins its first large-scale US battery project, and the 'world's largest' second-life EV battery factory opens in just six weeks. Meanwhile, hydrogen for heavy trucks is declared 'dead' by Sinopec, the world's second-largest oil company. [Iberdrola](https://electrek.co/2026/07/02/iberdrola-kicks-off-its-first-large-scale-battery-project-in-the-us/) | [Second-life battery](https://electrek.co/2026/07/02/worlds-largest-second-life-ev-battery-factory-opens-in-just-six-weeks/) | [Hydrogen dead](https://electrek.co/2026/07/02/hydrogen-for-heavy-trucks-is-dead-says-worlds-2nd-largest-oil-company/)
- **HackNews Community Highlights:** The conversion of rustc to C (crustc project) and the long-awaited LMDB 1.0 release demonstrate deep technical innovation. The 'Free Market Lie' post comparing Swiss and US internet speeds sparks debate on regulatory frameworks. [crustc](https://github.com/FractalFir/crustc) | [LMDB 1.0](http://www.lmdb.tech/doc/) | [Free Market Lie](https://stefan.schueller.net/posts/the-free-market-lie/)

**Watch next:** The interplay between AI cost containment and privacy regulation will intensify as companies seek to monetize data while consumers push back. The EV market faces a critical juncture: Tesla's FSD liability, Polestar's ban, and the rise of Chinese competitors like BYD will test automakers' ability to adapt. Keep an eye on the FTC's response to privacy complaints and the outcome of the SpaceX-Cursor deal for signals on AI platform independence.

sports.zh:
今日体育世界，世界杯淘汰赛战火正旺，葡萄牙与克罗地亚一战因VAR判罚引爆争议，C罗续写传奇而莫德里奇悲情告别；西班牙轻松晋级16强，英格兰为应对墨西哥魔鬼主场秘密备战。与此同时，中国篮球传来积极信号——郭昊文放弃CBA高薪，成为今夏唯一征战NBA夏季联赛的中国球员；羽毛球新星孙俪元亚青赛退赛令人惋惜。虎扑社区中，电竞选手Bin自信放言、猛龙重金追逐伦纳德等话题持续发酵。后续观察：葡萄牙与西班牙的伊比利亚德比即将上演，郭昊文夏联首秀值得期待，孙俪元伤情需追踪。

- [VAR争议改写结局，葡萄牙2-1力克克罗地亚，C罗与莫德里奇命运交错](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cz0jee3vy39o) — 第91分钟格瓦迪奥尔进球被判越位，克罗地亚无缘扳平，葡萄牙将在16强对阵西班牙。这不仅是技术判罚的焦点，更意味着37岁的C罗延续世界杯梦想，而38岁的莫德里奇悲壮离场。赛后葡萄牙全队还向一年前去世的迪奥戈·若塔致敬。
- [西班牙3-0轻取奥地利，低调英雄奥亚萨瓦尔闪光](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cvgd0jz1xq7o) — 无锋阵运转流畅，奥亚萨瓦尔成为球队淘汰赛关键支点，西班牙正逐步进入争冠节奏。
- [英格兰秘密备战墨西哥，防噪音设备曝光](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c74y7jwj30eo) — 三狮军团在墨西哥主场面临球迷巨大声浪，通过秘密地点和睡眠设备确保状态，准备工作细致入微。
- [中国篮球：郭昊文放弃高薪，独闯NBA夏季联赛](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPQy1ENEtUT1FPeGRxcEI0YWZacUlLT0VqdGM1OFJCOEswb2ZyMzM3SVJvbjVSYWdvSkJ4dWY2aDdkSW1hR0VxUHpsOVp5TFVnTHQ0UzFnWE1lMk1uQkg5aVlJdzVFSmVmbUItQXpsYm5yQVZ3Y2x5aGlCSWloX0pzalVXYVRHNy12Q2huRA) — 这位CBA后卫跳出舒适区，将为冲击NBA梦想而战，其勇气值得中国球迷关注。
- [孙俪元亚青赛退赛，国羽年轻世代再遇波折](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9PYkFSRW9FdGd1ekVTZTRlU3VNOFdObUdzQXlEMXRabGdMR0NtQURLRVlla0Q5ckhva3plNlV1RTZ2TmdnQllfMjNYZVZVSEVjOW50bDZOS0ZVdkFlRWVQa1g2UQ) — 这位新星因伤退赛，无缘亚洲青年锦标赛，成长之路需耐心。
- [虎扑投票世界杯小组赛最佳阵容出炉](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE4zYmxJaC1KQmRWTXFhNE9ORVdlTXQwTUlvcXU1OVc1S1c5UHFHV1VoZVVibHNWN1g5ZGV0dWhhTkh2M3RXS2hlNkNDbk5UWkpNQXBpdkRSTkdnNWRwX1VrQTlmMA) — 球迷票选结果：姆巴佩、哈兰德、贝林厄姆、B费等入围，反映本届赛事表现突出球员。
- [猛龙有意伦纳德：2年1.26亿顶薪报价](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTFBHa21aN20tVV94U0NFSnF5a0FJbmZaNEhreWhKMjJGZGJocUdHampuZ0I0dmRXYURSU1lBQTFDLXNjSjFKbWJVZk1zcTZQblZpdUgzd2d3WlBoRWNUZWJwWURibVJsNVlLVE9pejVmZ0Zadw) — 多伦多试图迎回昔日冠军核心，但伦纳德健康状况和选择仍是悬念。

**后续观察**：葡萄牙vs西班牙的伊比利亚德比将是16强最受瞩目的对决；郭昊文在NBA夏联的表现将检验中国球员与世界水平差距；孙俪元伤情恢复情况关系到国羽女单未来储备。
sports.en:
The 2026 World Cup knockout stage delivered high drama as Portugal edged Croatia 2-1 thanks to a controversial VAR decision that denied Croatia a stoppage-time equalizer, keeping Cristiano Ronaldo's tournament alive. Spain cruised past Austria, England fine-tuned preparations for Mexico, and the British sports scene saw mixed results at Wimbledon and Formula 1. Meanwhile, Chinese basketball player Guo Haowen is headed to the NBA Summer League, and badminton junior star Sun Liyuan withdrew from the Asian Junior Championships.

- **World Cup: Portugal survive VAR scare** – Portugal beat Croatia 2-1 in Toronto, with Ronaldo and Goncalo Ramos scoring. A late Josko Gvardiol goal was ruled out for offside after VAR review, setting up a last-16 tie with Spain. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cz0jee3vy39o) | [Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/football/portugal-vs-croatia/report/549850)
- **Spain ease past Austria** – Spain won 3-0 in Los Angeles, with Mikel Oyarzabal continuing his standout form. They face a potentially softer path in the knockout rounds. [Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/football/spain-vs-austria/report/549849)
- **England prepare for noisy Mexico** – England are using secret training locations and sleep devices to counter boisterous Mexican fans ahead of their last-16 match. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c74y7jwj30eo)
- **Wimbledon: last Brit standing** – Arthur Fery became the sole British singles player to reach the third round after Katie Swan, Jacob Fearnley, and Jan Choinski lost. [Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/tennis/news/12040/13559889/wimbledon-arthur-fery-becomes-last-british-player-standing-as-katie-swan-jacob-fearnley-and-jan-choinski-bow-out)
- **F1: Hamilton promises eighth title** – Lewis Hamilton told Silverstone fans he 'won't stop until we get there' in his pursuit of a record eighth world title. Kimi Antonelli insisted he retains championship momentum against George Russell despite recent setbacks. [Sky Sports: Hamilton](https://www.skysports.com/f1/news/12040/13559728/lewis-hamilton-ferrari-driver-wont-stop-in-formula-1-until-he-wins-record-eighth-world-title) | [Sky Sports: Antonelli](https://www.skysports.com/f1/news/12040/13559726/kimi-antonelli-mercedes-driver-says-he-still-has-championship-momentum-against-george-russell-ahead-of-british-gp)
- **Basketball: Guo Haowen to NBA Summer League** – The CBA player is the only Chinese participant in this year's NBA Summer League, turning down a high salary back home. [搜狐](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPQy1ENEtUT1FPeGRxcEI0YWZacUlLT0VqdGM1OFJCOEswb2ZyMzM3SVJvbjVSYWdvSkJ4dWY2aDdkSW1hR0VxUHpsOVp5TFVnTHQ0UzFnWE1lMk1uQkg5aVlJdzVFSmVmbUItQXpsYm5yQVZ3Y2x5aGlCSWloX0pzalVXYVRHNy12Q2huRA)
- **Badminton: Sun Liyuan withdraws** – The Chinese junior star has pulled out of the Asian Junior Championships, reason undisclosed. [新浪](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9PYkFSRW9FdGd1ekVTZTRlU3VNOFdObUdzQXlEMXRabGdMR0NtQURLRVlla0Q5ckhva3plNlV1RTZ2TmdnQllfMjNYZVZVSEVjOW50bDZOS0ZVdkFlRWVQa1g2UQ)
- **Hupu community: NBA trade rumors & MSI** – Raptors reportedly offered Leonard a 2-year $126M max, and are pursuing Ingram. In MSI, T1 beat TLAW in play-ins, while BLG's Bin confidently ranks himself as top MSI top laner. [Hupu: Leonard](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTFBHa21aN20tVV94U0NFSnF5a0FJbmZaNEhreWhKMjJGZGJocUdHampuZ0I0dmRXYURSU1lBQTFDLXNjSjFKbWJVZk1zcTZQblZpdUgzd2d3WlBoRWNUZWJwWURibVJsNVlLVE9pejVmZ0Zadw) | [Hupu: Bin interview](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5nTW5XaTlnYVhOSklTcC0zU1J3c0RoWlFfTG1nNmdLM2pNakFsS2NhQ0oyZS1va3VaSF84VElIUnJkdzZwVGJyUkxCNmdzQlptNGlGWG1JM0NGSXl5WU9rYURicw)

In F1, British Grand Prix qualifying on Saturday will set the grid. The NBA free agency rumor mill and MSI play-ins continue to dominate Hupu discussions.

entertainment.en:
The entertainment landscape this week is dominated by two powerful forces: the rapid integration of AI into filmmaking and the release of a triumphant new Madonna album. Across Asia, a livestream conflict in China and G-Dragon's UNESCO appointment signal shifting cultural dynamics, while Hollywood buzzes around Taylor Swift's wedding plans and the FIFA World Cup's celebrity invasion. Here are the key stories to watch:

- **AI in Film: Savior or Scourge?** Two contrasting AI narratives emerged: Director Jon Erwin detailed how AI made 'Young Washington' 'safer and more affordable' ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/young-washington-director-jon-erwin-ai-1236801002/)), while Jodie Foster sparked debate by claiming last year's 'F1' was made with AI, arguing it's already pervasive ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/jodie-foster-thinks-f1-was-made-with-ai-wasnt-it-1236973717/)). The industry is split on transparency.

- **Madonna Reignites the Dance Floor:** Critics are unanimous: 'Confessions II' is Madonna's best album in two decades. Both [Variety](https://variety.com/2026/music/album-reviews/madonna-confessions-ii-album-review-1236801149/) and [Rolling Stone](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-album-reviews/madonna-confessions-ii-album-review-1235588293/) gave rave reviews, calling it a nonstop groove that recaptures her throne as the queen of pop.

- **Hong Kong Box Office Revival:** The market surged 25% in the first half of 2026, reaching $84.7M, buoyed by local hit 'Night King' and strong Hollywood slate ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/hong-kong-box-office-night-king-avatar-cold-war-1994-1236973354/)). A sign that the beleaguered cinema sector is healing.

- **China Livestream Drama:** A live conflict between tech influencer Tim (影视飓风) and guest 'Chinese Boy' went viral, with accusations of staged drama and eventual on-air apologies dominating Chinese social media ([新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTFByY1c4LUpfWG5PbHRDWXNRQm56Xy1HTnJNenI0Q0VodV9uNF96by1xblJCdFU3elphX1UxcE1KZ2VONXo0aFo3SWl1WmJyNk05anhLXzFHLTBBazIzaTFHVFQyS2NscXU4Q2gyWkEwb0Q)). The incident underscores the volatility of live streaming culture.

- **G-Dragon Goes Diplomatic:** BIGBANG's G-Dragon was named honorary ambassador for the 48th session of the UNESCO World Heritage Committee, a move that bridges K-pop and global heritage ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1851985wpp/bigbangs-g-dragon-named-ambassador-for-unesco-world-heritage-committee)). His influence now extends beyond music.

- **Taylor Swift's Wedding Watch:** Rehearsal dinner guests including Jack Antonoff and Lena Dunham were spotted at MSG, fueling speculation about the date ([Rolling Stone](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/taylor-swift-travis-kelce-wedding-rehearsal-dinner-guests-1235588737/)). The celebrity gathering is a major pop culture event.

- **Weibo's Visual Trends:** Actor Wang Junkai's shoulder-baring photos and Chen Duling's 'dark siren' transformation dominated Weibo discussions, while singer Zhang Yuanying's fearless rollercoaster visuals went viral ([新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE5VT1NtRmtwZ184MGZka05DZllnRFJReUFqNE5jMGFHajNiZXpxRksyRDVBWlc0SGE3dlV0RnlZUTVjbE5Dcm44aENGV083QVJPaExVX2l0RVN6NUktREVRYVEyZHl3VV9mX05hLUp0cXM)). Visuals are the new currency of online fame.

**Watch next:** The AI debate will intensify as 'Young Washington' hits theaters; Madonna's album will likely debut at number one; and China's crackdown on group livestreams could reshape the influencer economy. Keep an eye on the Taylor Swift wedding date reveal and G-Dragon's UNESCO activities.

美股.en:
U.S. stocks closed mixed on Thursday after a disappointing June jobs report. The Dow Jones Industrial Average hit a record closing high, while the Nasdaq fell on weakness in chip shares. Nvidia unveiled a revenue-sharing program for startups, and Tesla tumbled despite strong deliveries.

- Nonfarm payrolls added only 57,000 in June, far below the 115,000 consensus, and prior two months revised down by 74,000. The unemployment rate dipped to 4.2% as labor force participation hit a 50-year low outside of Covid. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/02/jobs-report-june-2026-.html)
- Nvidia announced a program allowing AI startups to swap compute power for a share of future profits, aiming to lock in demand. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/02/nvidia-plans-to-offer-start-up-customers-access-to-revenue-sharing-deals.html)
- Tesla shares fell 7% despite reporting strong Q2 deliveries, as the company struggles with consumer backlash against CEO Elon Musk. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/02/tesla-tsla-q2-2026-vehicle-delivery-production.html)
- President Trump bought Apple and Nvidia shares before his tariff reversal fueled a market rebound, raising questions about timing. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/02/trump-aapl-nvda-tariffs-disclosures.html)
- Wall Street profit forecasts are surging, prompting fears of an "earnings bubble." [Financial Times via Google News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE84akJ2RERwTWFTWU1Ya0RnY3A0N19BVUtfbXJ2RDdyQzhoQldvY25RQ0pyZ1ZtV29kR3lpTEdLdUVfcFdVdTdaZGNRU0JLZV9mZmlYcnZfLVBkS29Pb3Rua2lpWHRQc2F5Y0pJcVhmcWE)

Signal: The weak jobs data reinforces bets on a Fed pause, but the surge in profit forecasts suggests markets are pricing in an unrealistic growth scenario.

欧洲经济.en:
European stocks traded cautiously as ECB President Lagarde defended the latest rate hike, while analysts warned of repeating the 2011 austerity mistake. Eurozone unemployment remained at a record low, contrasting with the U.S. slowdown. Central bankers at the Sintra forum focused on AI's impact on monetary policy.

- ECB President Christine Lagarde defended the rate hike decision, emphasizing the need to curb inflation despite recession risks. [ECB Interview](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/inter/date/2026/html/ecb.in260702~c56db179c3.en.html)
- A detailed analysis warns that the ECB risks repeating the 2011 mistake of tightening too much as inflation remains elevated. [equiti.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimgFBVV95cUxQRGdlcG12OHRfMXJOc1hiZnF2Rmd6RWlPb0xaWjIyWi1jTEpadk9QSThGOGxfc2FfNzFYdWdad1h2RXhRWC14eUN6RjlCY0RPTGxWdEh2S2VQT1NjQkxvTEJ1ZWRyQTd4cjVSR0xXSFo2UVFkMG9TUlFCUDNmNVI0WHJyemFBYVluTVFMNDhvVWtEMzR0MUpGYUpB)
- Eurozone unemployment held at a record low, providing a contrast to the U.S. slowdown. [IndexBox](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxNRmFTdXh1dDVtWDQ5QnJ0c2VNYlQ5aGdMaUhOU1RLb1VUWVMwXzVoNkVFejVxSTlhcmFaeng5Vnp0Tzg1TnpBYk51S1dhbDhSYmFvX2NZT0t5NlhZenViaG13b2U3NzBsMlRmM1RQajNEM29kcXJlQVAzUWR6NkFUeFk0cGRJdjF6ZGhLMUVqYVlZQ3B0ZThablpwQ2lDVXlNT3NocEsxWQ)
- ECB board members delivered speeches on digital transformation of money and the green transition. [Piero Cipollone](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/key/date/2026/html/ecb.sp260702_1~c58dcd8150.en.pdf), [Frank Elderson](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/key/date/2026/html/ecb.sp260702~49c4f8e9a6.en.html)
- AI hopes and fears dominated discussions at the central bankers' meeting in Portugal, with implications for productivity and inflation. [Daily Sabah](https://news.google.)

Signal: If the ECB pushes ahead with further hikes amid weakening demand, the eurozone could face a sharper slowdown, but a record-low unemployment rate gives the bank some cover.

中国经济.en:
China’s equity markets saw mixed signals. A-share indices edged higher, with robotics and AI stocks leading. However, bubble fears in AI stocks intensified after a 65% H1 surge. Hong Kong IPO pipeline is congested, while Chinese investment banks posted strong H1 earnings. Sportswear sales slumped despite the World Cup.

- China’s AI stocks surged 65% in the first half, but hedge fund manager Michael Burry warned of a bubble, and US investors are increasingly bearish on the global AI trade. [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3359195/chinas-ai-stocks-surge-65-first-half-bubble-fears-begin-weigh-sentiment)
- Insurance funds accelerated purchases of Hong Kong-listed stocks in Q2; Ping An Group added over HK$10 billion of China Life H-shares. [Moomoo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxNM2NQWmMzdXVVTEtUOUJQZFZibFpyc0dJM1haaXY2MlYzcUJ4OElLSWhxQXFJdUhMeU4zWXdsWE05V1pjNHNCSVh6RDZkMzUyRmg0cWtXaG9DUFMyenBtRmdqZTFoOUFLQ1BFRUFYamtYTlpWcWx4REhhVlFQN1ZhSW1tVnVBVllpVzN1QWFMZFlpVlpHYmJQbEpOeklzQTR0b1oxR05WbWN4QVU)
- Over 430 mainland Chinese companies are waiting for IPO approval in Hong Kong, many at risk of application expiry. [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3359108/clogged-pipeline-many-hong-kong-ipo-hopefuls-near-application-expiration)
- Chinese investment banks (CICC, Huatai) posted strong H1 earnings, overtaking global rivals in Hong Kong IPO underwriting. [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3359242/chinese-banks-surge-ahead-amid-hong-kongs-ipo-wave-challenging-global-giants), [IndexBox](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxNX3gxdXFlSkxrbFFHZUFNZ0NCUThfX1hGV1gwSjNGMFpKUTFadko3dDZoeW5sN0FETHgzX1RVNDlqdDVmUWx0dGNnOXBfdk81blNZcEVUdVljSEh3bEsweV9sS3hwNGQxUmd2SHg0enFLZnNLVnlZNEZuREdTVTRkcG83YTlNNUFObmZLMG5DZ052V1ZLeGtRQ0hZVUpQdw)
- Sportswear brands (Nike, Adidas, Arc’teryx) saw declining in-store sales in China in May despite the World Cup, indicating weak consumer demand. [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3359176/sportswear-firms-fail-score-world-cup-amid-china-sales-slump)
- Hong Kong will launch a gold clearing and settlement system next week, a move to enhance its financial infrastructure. [SCMP](https://news.google.)

Signal: Investors should watch for the sustainability of China's AI rally and whether Hong Kong's IPO pipeline clears, which would signal renewed confidence in mainland companies.

同花顺社区动态.en:
The popular Chinese trading app 同花顺 (Hithink RoyalFlush) experienced a system crash on Friday morning, causing widespread user disruption and trending on social media. The company confirmed the outage, stated it has been resolved, and is investigating the root cause. Separately, new account openings data showed strong growth in June.

- 同花顺 app crashed on July 3 morning, prompting a flood of complaints on social media; the company responded that operators were urgently investigating. [Sina Finance](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxQRkJnX0tKajYtbkNiUGxhWmxNMWc3NFkxNWhBV0dnWTJFLTZfMUt4aUNJOXJwdEVtYXRCNHQtR0FVZlVIb0pkU1FGdkR0M2hrU0dUenNNeUROSzZtVTFrZzR1YmJ2TFdxaEJFMUc2RWxuZ19hS2txWlVZT2U5cFFZUk90NWhmb2NobWV6eENzb240ZVNZck9OVXo3NWwzeEk)
- The outage lasted for a few hours; service was restored by mid-morning, and the cause is still being investigated. [Huxiu](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE5tT1Qza3kyek5UUGV6MVA4T3VfdzBnc3Zidy1XQzlMOFp6M1djVElLZVhVeEk4M3VRejRFVGJ2ZzRlaGEwdUlLRjV3M1RhRXVYaHNn)
- In June, A-share new stock accounts opened reached 2.8646 million, up 73.99% year-on-year, and 20.1614 million cumulative in 2026. Fund new accounts were 233,600, up 16.57% YoY. [同花顺 Finance](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9UUjZUM25YVG5ucDNFd24xRVNad3lJc1hZbUNkUTRaMzAwUEwtNjVhdnU2QnFZQVlVMlBBT0tlYXVaZmVQbzBFVTl4Y3JuU192M0dLUFRuakp5T0xzWXc)
- A post on the 同花顺 community discussed the Dow Jones index, reflecting retail investor appetite for US markets. [Moomoo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTE1FeENpYzhXQ3N6c0QwMTBXOTNVSmlZeGpsSkg0V1ZDajdHYWtOMm9GWnpXUGFjT0I5TDkzNmdTaEZVeENybXpETVk0d0dEd095TXEyQjV2NVl3ekswSVRRTw)

Signal: The crash highlights the critical dependence of Chinese retail traders on this platform; any prolonged outage could disrupt trading and sentiment. The surge in new accounts indicates continued retail investor enthusiasm.

欧美.zh: 过去24小时，欧美社会新闻的核心是战争与能源博弈。俄罗斯对基辅发动了自开战以来最大规模空袭，造成至少30人死亡，NPR最初报道18人，后续BBC确认30人，反映出袭击烈度与伤亡统计的持续上升（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c4gyv05gk4do?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)、[NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/02/nx-s1-5878894/russia-attacks-ukraines-capital-killing-more-than-a-dozen-people)）。与此同时，加拿大总理卡尼推动的输油管道协议旨在打破对美依赖，回应特朗普的贸易战（[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/7/3/canadas-carney-secures-deal-for-pipeline-to-expand-oil-exports-beyond-us?traffic_source=rss)）。伊朗在霍尔木兹海峡发出警告，使波斯湾航运风险骤升（[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/7/3/iran-warns-ships-against-using-unapproved-routes-in-strait-of-hormuz?traffic_source=rss)）。此外，梵蒂冈正式绝罚圣庇护十世会约60万信众，标志天主教内部裂痕加深（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c5yz95188jjo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)）。特朗普加密货币收益超10亿美元引发伦理争议（[NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/02/nx-s1-5877487/trump-crypto-earnings-ethics)）。这些事件共同勾勒出大国对抗、资源博弈与制度性冲突并存的图景。
欧美.en:
The 欧美 desk was dominated by the escalating conflict in Ukraine, with Russia launching a massive attack on Kyiv that killed at least 30 people, using advanced missiles and drones. This event is coupled with broader geopolitical shifts: Canada announced a pipeline to reduce US energy dependence, and Iran warned ships in the Strait of Hormuz amid fragile US-Iran talks. Additionally, the Vatican excommunicated the traditionalist Society of Saint Pius X, affecting 600,000 followers, while a former US Olympian was indicted for vandalizing the Washington Reflecting Pool. The Trump family’s $1 billion crypto earnings also sparked ethics concerns.

- **Kyiv Under Massive Attack:** Russia's "most massive" barrage of the war on Kyiv killed at least 30, with emergency crews digging through rubble ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c4gyv05gk4do?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/02/nx-s1-5878894/russia-attacks-ukraines-capital-killing-more-than-a-dozen-people)). This signals an escalation in urban warfare.
- **Canada Diversifies Oil Exports:** PM Carney's pipeline deal aims to export oil beyond the US, directly countering Trump's trade war ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/7/3/canadas-carney-secures-deal-for-pipeline-to-expand-oil-exports-beyond-us?traffic_source=rss)). This could reshape North American energy flows.
- **Iran Issues Hormuz Threat:** Iran warned ships against unapproved routes in the Strait of Hormuz, a day after Qatari mediators reported progress in US-Iran talks ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/7/3/iran-warns-ships-against-using-unapproved-routes-in-strait-of-hormuz?traffic_source=rss)). This raises the risk of maritime disruption.
- **Vatican Excommunicates 600,000:** The Society of Saint Pius X was declared in schism over doctrinal differences ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c5yz95188jjo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)). A rare and significant disciplinary action.
- **Trump Crypto Conflict of Interest:** Former ethics lawyer Richard Painter said Trump's $1 billion crypto earnings pose a "clear conflict of interest" ([NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/02/nx-s1-5877487/trump-crypto-earnings-ethics)). This adds to ongoing ethics debates.

**Signal:** The convergence of military escalation in Ukraine, energy realignment in North America, and a new flashpoint in the Strait of Hormuz points to a volatile geopolitical landscape.

日韩.zh: 韩国金融市场经历剧烈震荡，Kospi指数暴跌近8%跌破8000点，芯片股因AI需求预期骤冷而遭抛售（[Korea Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE1BbTdqS1duWEJ3Z0l3ck9faVJkUFk1RE9kWUJhdkNWcHgzVlowbUExamZWNU9qWnVBRTMwT21aM2dRTWRicmd1ZmJjdU9nRE1FMTJtV3l0bw)），全球科技股承压。乌克兰外长透露俄方曾提议用数千战俘交换被俘朝鲜士兵，凸显战场外交易（[Korea Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE50ZUZud2dUNG1pU2RPWEp4Y0UtTjFmSkF4ZnNPQW42bTBpUWdiOWJqOFBHRXQ0c3JXWXBmTXpEV21fTGhIQl9FRWpacFF4UURMM2Y2c2VwZw)）。日本方面，东京一家医院设立的“婴儿邮箱”一年内接收20名新生儿，引发社会对遗弃与救助机制的讨论（[Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxQM0pmeEQtaFpLYUJ1NXVRY3Y5UnJ2dmhKSDhnb2FISjJaSmFCQWo1STNKa1FzSWlVOEpIQW54Qk5ILXdfWGw5VVQ2Q3dBZGk0SnluTG5pSkJlWlBfYzczU3VMVXFBbUdZOGpiR0ZFRzlLbjRIQ1pRMkkyNXpObHhuTTd1MmxTbERaVjZhRWd3)）。韩日两国重申朝鲜半岛无核化承诺，但中国官媒《环球时报》呼吁首尔对东京的防卫扩张保持清醒（[Ratopati](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixAFBVV95cUxOX3V1VlAxaUlXTjVmMW5VLWdOTVdjZmRMTFpyVmhRYXhPaVhCdFo4Tlp0V0lFQS1zWGE0blJRZVdjVzdJLTQ3aF9KQzR5aFRsejlsQWl0cy1GbS1sQ2p5Z3JaR3BtMHlzamlyTnl3UjUxM1BVekJURV9KbnR3WGFxR3EwRDVOODdiNlQ1ZmkxMWxGcDNNOEtFRW1xNWF6ZHcwMjB4Vnh5Nmk0M3czSjJVSjNUX3U3M0w2bllTUTA0LUVudFJh)）。整体上，日韩正面临外部经济冲击与安全焦虑的双重挑战。
日韩.en:
The 日韩 desk saw South Korea's stock market take a severe hit as the Kospi fell below 8,000 on fears of weakening AI demand, affecting chip giant stocks. Meanwhile, diplomatic and security dynamics continue: Ukraine's foreign minister claimed Russia offered thousands of POWs for captured North Koreans, and Japan-South Korea relations are active with currency talks and reaffirmation of denuclearization. A Tokyo hospital's baby hatch accepted 20 newborns in its first year, a social policy note.

- **Kospi Sell-Off on AI Fears:** South Korea's Kospi plunged nearly 8% as chip stocks tumbled amid concerns of a global slowdown in AI demand ([Korea Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE1BbTdqS1duWEJ3Z0l3ck9faVJkUFk1RE9kWUJhdkNWcHgzVlowbUExamZWNU9qWnVBRTMwT21aM2dRTWRicmd1ZmJjdU9nRE1FMTJtV3l0bw)). Investors are reassessing the AI capex cycle.
- **North Korean POWs in Ukraine:** Ukraine's foreign minister allegedly said Russia offered thousands of its own POWs in exchange for captured North Korean soldiers ([Korea Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE50ZUZud2dUNG1pU2RPWEp4Y0UtTjFmSkF4ZnNPQW42bTBpUWdiOWJqOFBHRXQ0c3JXWXBmTXpEV21fTGhIQl9FRWpacFF4UURMM2Y2c2VwZw)). If confirmed, this would confirm North Korean combat involvement.
- **Japan and South Korea Reaffirm Nuclear-Free Peninsula:** Both countries restated commitment to a non-nuclear Korean Peninsula ([Ratopati](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixAFBVV95cUxOX3V1VlAxaUlXTjVmMW5VLWdOTVdjZmRMTFpyVmhRYXhPaVhCdFo4Tlp0V0lFQS1zWGE0blJRZVdjVzdJLTQ3aF9KQzR5aFRsejlsQWl0cy1GbS1sQ2p5Z3JaR3BtMHlzamlyTnl3UjUxM1BVekJURV9KbnR3WGFxR3EwRDVOODdiNlQ1ZmkxMWxGcDNNOEtFRW1xNWF6ZHcwMjB4Vnh5Nmk0M3czSjJVSjNUX3U3M0w2bllTUTA0LUVudFJh)). A signal of united policy amid regional tensions.
- **Tokyo Hospital Baby Hatch Accepts 20:** A Tokyo hospital's baby hatch received 20 newborns in its first year, highlighting an ongoing need for anonymous infant surrender options in Japan ([Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxQM0pmeEQtaFpLYUJ1NXVRY3Y5UnJ2dmhKSDhnb2FISjJaSmFCQWo1STNKa1FzSWlVOEpIQW54Qk5ILXdfWGw5VVQ2Q3dBZGk0SnluTG5pSkJlWlBfYzczU3VMVXFBbUdZOGpiR0ZFRzlLbjRIQ1pRMkkyNXpObHhuTTd1MmxTbERaVjZhRWd3)).

**Signal:** The Kospi crash and North Korean POW rumors could rattle investor and diplomatic stability in the region.

中国.zh: 中国社会新闻以政策民生与国际合作为主线。国务院印发《教育发展“十五五”规划》，为未来五年教育定调（[证券时报](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXEFVX3lxTE1kSTNYVXA5b1hjZE8wZEczd0tJVVF3SlRNeF9VTldiZXBybFZoZzdxWmQwajVHSEQtZzBBWTBpS2hYQ0RIR0ZfZlR5S1ZaNXVwYWJWVDJ6WlJrVEta)）。人社部延续实施失业保险稳岗扩岗政策，采取“两延续一优化”组合拳（[新华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE9iMXZjeWtuVGRua1VNQUVUSENCZjBCX0lVWXNqMHF5X2Y1aXdLdlBZMDlZd21udk8ycURoWHNUMUM4cVVyVUJuY2trVThqUVlZSHpHNEdLRE84dVlRdXhmN2U4dEJHVDhvalFkWDJDUWNDWmhqb01acmtIcF9PNk0)），直接稳定就业预期。国际方面，第二批援刚果（金）中国医疗专家组启程（[央广网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE9XTDBYaS0wanRxWno0TXpONzRsVFg0UlVVVTZ0RU5sMkRSbmxvYmRqdjB6a2gzTnVCcVQwWEVPU041SjdOZG5XOWVnVFpmVG1PT0d0M1UzRURzWVlvZzZ3RWgxeWU0blJJZDZNVFdnRWVEOHVKWkhsOVptdzd2dHM)），C909医疗机首次亮相中亚（[中国民航网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTE9tVW84TFRFaE5weXo1MldHZGxGVmNQUzAtWGJocHF0Y0d5WEpQUzBpTjA5S3k2WVViQ0oyczNWUnozeVliTlItWjg1NjhGdmtOb3RKWTZvOTNhbmJteTZGQ3hObmhrdUZJTldGWA)），展现中国医疗外交与航空工业突破。此外，中国式现代化成就图片展在塔吉克斯坦举行（[新华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE5OVUtlRWVjRVVFaXVHTmJJRXVocjRFRG5wNi00YzBXRGhLWXp1TVg0aXJ3M0VFekRPcW9wdG5sbHdNVHZFdmQ2WHVJbDJ4VnV0a0xWUjNUVWZRMWpsLTU2RTlsb3ROYTIzTHFieXNVYXZhbVRKbmk0QjNmR05XMmM)），配合七一党建105周年活动，整体基调积极。
中国.en:
The 中国 desk features a mix of policy announcements and positive state narratives. The State Council released the '15th Five-Year Plan' for education, signaling long-term human capital priorities. Employment support policies were extended, and a new disability service framework for the next five years was announced. AI is a recurring theme, with Medtronic's China head discussing AI-driven health management and educational applications of AI being highlighted. A medical variant of the C909 aircraft made its debut in Central Asia, showcasing Chinese aerospace capabilities. Party-building and ideological education remain prominent.

- **Education 15th Five-Year Plan Released:** The State Council issued the 'Education Development 15th Five-Year Plan', a major policy blueprint ([Securities Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXEFVX3lxTE1kSTNYVXA5b1hjZE8wZEczd0tJVVF3SlRNeF9VTldiZXBybFZoZzdxWmQwajVHSEQtZzBBWTBpS2hYQ0RIR0ZfZlR5S1ZaNXVwYWJWVDJ6WlJrVEta)). This will guide spending and reforms through 2030.
- **Employment Support Policies Extended:** The government announced a 'two continuations, one optimization' package to support business hiring and stabilize jobs ([Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE9iMXZjeWtuVGRua1VNQUVUSENCZjBCX0lVWXNqMHF5X2Y1aXdLdlBZMDlZd21udk8ycURoWHNUMUM4cVVyVUJuY2trVThqUVlZSHpHNEdLRE84dVlRdXhmN2U4dEJHVDhvalFkWDJDUWNDWmhqb01acmtIcF9PNk0)). Aimed at countering economic headwinds.
- **Disability Service System to Improve:** A new five-year plan for disability services was unveiled by Xinhua, focusing on rehabilitation and social inclusion ([Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE5DS0hLcTNoNjVGamozUEotbFJENzVYckhtRG1kdWJCRlctM0Q4anUtVE5KQkNMZE1OSnZJaTdxUWlFR3ItVGRRVVEyOUZmZHRQc2Q3WjlpRkdybmJLNUdxOWVhODdmSmxnUC10V1FnakVFQU02Y3pyajF1bWF3SU0)).
- **AI in Healthcare and Education:** Medtronic's China head promoted AI-driven full-cycle health management ([21CAIJING](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxQZVNxSWRMTU1nVzlWekhXQUxuNGlEQm1qTlRWekR3N1VJajBrZlJneWZBXy1nazQtdERvX3FZV2NJWDVaV2RVdUNQYnJ2a3doSGVZM09CMFl2R1FpTjEzMHdyaUNXdDdtODk4QnJ4QlVCcUlRaFNrRWxUVk1ONXNMdHk4Q0pQNm02ZDlzdw)), while experts discussed AI needs in universities ([edu.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE9kRGlTcXlIQnFyN3l2M011a2lEamM0Vnc1RHE2SnR4NzR2bDJjRFhnV2t2ZDh0SVZZMmppcmdvbFpsT2FlYWlYMjdZOXJhekx1bHprUDZyalQwWW82anZSTE93YXpaNXFKVy1ZSDVxNHp1X0hKRkhkYg)).
- **C909 Medical Plane Debuts in Central Asia:** The C909 medical aircraft was showcased for the first time in Central Asia, indicating Chinese aerospace export ambitions ([China Civil Aviation](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTE9tVW84TFRFaE5weXo1MldHZGxGVmNQUzAtWGJocHF0Y0d5WEpQUzBpTjA5S3k2WVViQ0oyczNWUnozeVliTlItWjg1NjhGdmtOb3RKWTZvOTNhbmJteTZGQ3hObmhrdUZJTldGWA)).

**Signal:** China’s policy focus on education, employment, and AI reflects a dual strategy of managing near-term economic pressures while investing in long-term technological competitiveness.

知乎社区动态.zh: 知乎社区近24小时动态呈现商业化焦虑与娱乐热点交织。知乎2025年财报显示营收同比下滑23.6%，CEO周源明确将加速AI商业化探索（[财联社](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1BSGJZY202VWVwaHF6NTA3V3Z3MUZHVENZVHVIWmI4YW1BY3NRa2VpVkx0QVE2bUw5MXphSGJjQmpXa002OXN0YQ)），同时公司以14.71万美元回购1.4万股，试图稳定股价（[新浪财经](https://news.google.)）。行业首份《品牌AI内容资产库建设指南》发布，反映品牌营销对AI工具的迫切需求（[新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE9WLW9pdFA1aFB3RVNqNmNuaENIc3N5eE55TVVqU3hRTERDRlRzYzEyS253VkE3WDViaGVUX2NkTXJ1SjVUWkMtTDYyVUtNa1hSd1B4dzB4YWFxdHo1RGExbjJPYkc1Z2JWQ2huLWQ2YU1HNzVMcldiQnZfOU5mTkU)）。娱乐板块中，苏志燮新剧《温柔爸爸》引发全网讨论，光线电影《谋杀者的告白》定档7月16日开机（[360娱乐](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE9rYno4d1MyMVVPSkd1cFN1ZjR5QVQ1a1BwV09nY3VUNG4zVVBucFVVa1o5TUV3OVBpZlB6RFQwUEFkZHltZDBVQlZTWHdHdm8)）。此外，唐嫣委托律所起诉网络侵权，显示明星维权力度加大（[新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5qTG4xa0hpY1Vvb0hIbHZ2TkpNT0ZsQlRzREpJek5Yc0xsMW11MUZER0hyRmdlbnp5a21iX0VvbDU0VllWX0c0TnU1TmNMTHlTNFBWbXo4alZRNWdCOVFGcklmQQ)）。整体来看，知乎社区正在内容商业化与用户体验之间艰难平衡。
知乎社区动态.en:
The 知乎 community desk highlights a mix of platform business news, entertainment, and legal actions. Zhihu's 2025 revenue fell 23.6%, and CEO Zhou Yuan emphasized accelerating AI commercialization, a clear strategic pivot. The platform also saw the release of the first industry guide on brand AI content asset libraries. In entertainment, a new Su Ji-sub drama and a film adaptation are trending. Legal news: actress Tang Yan has filed multiple defamation lawsuits against online users. A spammy post about World Cup platform safety also appears.

- **Zhihu Revenue Drops, AI Focus Intensifies:** Zhihu reported a 23.6% revenue decline for 2025; CEO Zhou Yuan is pushing AI monetization efforts ([Cailianshe](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1BSGJZY202VWVwaHF6NTA3V3Z3MUZHVENZVHVIWmI4YW1BY3NRa2VpVkx0QVE2bUw5MXphSGJjQmpXa002OXN0YQ)). This underscores challenges for content platforms.
- **Brand AI Content Asset Guide Published:** The industry's first guide on building brand AI content asset libraries was released, targeting marketers ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE9WLW9pdFA1aFB3RVNqNmNuaENIc3N5eE55TVVqU3hRTERDRlRzYzEyS253VkE3WDViaGVUX2NkTXJ1SjVUWkMtTDYyVUtNa1hSd1B4dzB4YWFxdHo1RGExbjJPYkc1Z2JWQ2huLWQ2YU1HNzVMcldiQnZfOU5mTkU)). Reflects growing convergence of AI and content.
- **Tang Yan Files Lawsuits Against Online Users:** Actress Tang Yan's law firm announced defamation lawsuits against multiple individuals for infringement of personality rights ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5qTG4xa0hpY1Vvb0hIbHZ2TkpNT0ZsQlRzREpJek5Yc0xsMW11MUZER0hyRmdlbnp5a21iX0VvbDU0VllWX0c0TnU1TmNMTHlTNFBWbXo4alZRNWdCOVFGcklmQQ)). A signal of stricter legal protection for celebrities.
- **Su Ji-sub Drama and Film News Trending:** A new drama featuring Su Ji-sub as a father flipping from gentle to violent is resonating with audiences ([360 Entertainment](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE9rYno4d1MyMVVPSkd1cFN1ZjR5QVQ1a1BwV09nY3VUNG4zVVBucFVVa1o5TUV3OVBpZlB6RFQwUEFkZHltZDBVQlZTWHdHdm8)). Also, a film 'Murderer's Confession' starring Lu Yuxiao and Li Xiaoqian is set to start shooting on July 16 ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE1ybThZSURVbnlTTm5yeVlXWVQxTGtSeFJrckNuRjN0MUhmOUZpc3FsSW9wN21ad0JvRkllTGNGTnpjd2dYdjFhS28xd3ZLUG10Q2ROb2R2YzMtazVtc3lKamVSOA)).
- **Zhihu Buys Back Shares:** Zhihu repurchased 14,000 shares for $147,100 on June 30, a confidence signal to the market ([Sina Finance](https://news.google.)).

**Signal:** Zhihu’s revenue decline and AI pivot, combined with celebrity legal actions, indicate a platform under pressure to reinvent itself and manage content risks.

冲突局势.zh: 俄乌冲突在24小时内升级为双向打击：乌军通过无人机和远程火力打击俄能源设施，造成俄国内加油站斗殴、物价飞涨与收成危机，而俄军则对基辅发动战争以来最大规模导弹袭击，致21人死亡。与此同时，乌克兰正在通过法律途径阻止俄占区非法小麦出口，形成[法律战场](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiUkFVX3lxTE9PamhtTllPWXJHSHZLTkN4clNRMVpEOEJ1NlotZ2QwMWVNeldXcjdlSlpJSzBvOHRJOVBNNjE4LS14ZUdYMnpJRnhmM0NwMTJHNmc)。《现代外交》分析这场战争已成为[耐力竞赛](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxOVzdzOVJTcHZjdHI1YnRWTHRGRDZwRGdXRUVuOExkMTBRU0tfMU1hNDhheXBRdU5sdk5Wb1NhdFVKM3ZENHRHMFRnSGx2dGpBRUsyNjN0RTc4SEpWU1FGTWlqZGV6cDVseHFLTEVhcVFaWjJ4Um1qRk9mVHhCN0ZqUjllWEhrUkZoQ192LUgxR05UWWxGcm4tbEl6VG1ocloz)，《华尔街日报》警示战争正威胁俄罗斯大国地位。双方均陷入“你打你的，我打我的”不对称消耗。
冲突局势.en:
The Russia-Ukraine war has become a contest of endurance, with Ukraine shifting to disrupt Russia’s internal stability through strikes on fuel and agriculture. A major Russian missile and drone barrage on Kyiv killed at least 21 people, but Ukraine simultaneously hit Russian domestic infrastructure, causing fistfights at gas stations and luxury prices. Meanwhile, the U.S. diplomat’s call for a Taiwanese drone ‘hornet’s nest’ highlights how drone warfare lessons are being applied globally.

- [Fistfights at the Pumps, Gas at Luxury Prices, and a Harvest at Risk — Ukraine's Strikes Are Hitting Russia Where It Hurts Most](https://news.google.) — National Security Journal
- [Russia bombards Kyiv in one of war’s biggest strikes, at least 21 people killed](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/07/02/russia-bombards-kyiv-in-one-of-wars-biggest-strikes-at-least-21-people-killed/) — Defense News
- [Why the Russia–Ukraine War Has Become a Contest of Endurance?](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxOVzdzOVJTcHZjdHI1YnRWTHRGRDZwRGdXRUVuOExkMTBRU0tfMU1hNDhheXBRdU5sdk5Wb1NhdFVKM3ZENHRHMFRnSGx2dGpBRUsyNjN0RTc4SEpWU1FGTWlqZGV6cDVseHFLTEVhcVFaWjJ4Um1qRk9mVHhCN0ZqUjllWEhrUkZoQ192LUgxR05UWWxGcm4tbEl6VG1ocloz) — Modern Diplomacy
- [Taiwan needs a ‘hornet’s nest’ of drones to deter conflict, US diplomat says](https://news.google.) — Al Jazeera

**Signal**: The war is no longer about territory alone; Ukraine is systematically attacking Russia’s economic and social cohesion, while Russia responds with mass strikes on civilians—a dangerous escalatory cycle that shows no signs of de-escalation.

国际安全.zh: 北约东翼与欧洲安全出现多重震荡。立陶宛以“局势恶化”为由推动解除核武器宪法禁令，标志波罗的海国家从常规防御转向核威慑。IISS报告确认俄罗斯“极有可能”是2024年以来席卷欧洲的无人机入侵潮的幕后黑手，且疑似利用[影子船](https://www.twz.com/air/russia-highly-likely-behind-drone-incursions-over-u-s-bases-in-england-report-concludes)发起袭击。美军装备方面，B-2轰炸机在“勇敢之盾”演习中首次使用LRASM击沉靶船，F-15EX与“幽灵蝙蝠”无人机编队展示了有人-无人协同新战力。美国防部另设无人系统直接报告投资组合经理，加速无人化转型。GAO报告则指出五角大楼仍在[关键武器开发时间线上挣扎](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxNNVU1RjBTeGhCVFNrSGJ1Qk1hbEF4SnpGbFRSNi05dDVmNHJlTkxuU2FqT0R6VUFOYWdjdG1WSWZ4RXRnUUJkRFd6NXphT0x3Tjc3aUhnZXl4TXB6QW5WaVZwVm9PaW9odXNlallXUWJzZ2JhczFyMUY1ZXFjMFBlRHJ0cGhvOUdlNWEtNDJJNFVmcGZHR0F1ejUyWDM0Tms2R3o5ZGVJRWZGQTFKMmg0)。
国际安全.en:
A comprehensive report by the IISS concludes Russia is “highly likely” behind a wave of drone incursions over U.S. bases in England and elsewhere in Europe, likely launched from shadow ships. In response, Lithuania’s parliament agreed to lift its constitutional ban on nuclear weapons and foreign bases, signaling a dramatic shift in Baltic security posture. Meanwhile, the Pentagon struggles with key weapons timelines—the GAO warns that developmental concerns for the Navy’s ‘Doomsday Plane’ have become realities—and the Navy is already seeking alternatives to the newly fielded AARGM-ER radar-busting missile.

- [Russia “Highly Likely” Behind Drone Incursions Over U.S. Bases In England Report Concludes](https://www.twz.com/air/russia-highly-likely-behind-drone-incursions-over-u-s-bases-in-england-report-concludes) — The War Zone
- [Lithuania moves to end nuclear weapon ban as ‘situation getting worse’](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/07/02/lithuania-moves-to-end-nuclear-weapon-ban-as-situation-getting-worse/) — Defense News
- [Navy’s New ‘Doomsday Plane’ Delayed As Watchdog Says Developmental Concerns Are Now Realities](https://www.twz.com/nuclear/navys-new-doomsday-plane-delayed-as-watchdog-says-developmental-concerns-are-now-realities) — The War Zone
- [Navy Already Looking For Alternatives To Its Brand New AARGM-ER Radar Busting Missile](https://www.twz.com/air/navy-already-looking-for-alternatives-to-its-brand-new-aargm-er-radar-busting-missile) — The War Zone
- [B-2 Sinks Target Ship in First-Ever LRASM Strike](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxNSVJlS1kzUG1xeEVWZG5jX3M1dFVXTTJKWmJGUE9rcFUtODRlS3c3aU5IUUlaQjNhSVl3MnlSYjJRdnJPanVoOVFQTzJteTd2bWNWU2tEbENQX05VaEJ4UmNVcFEtdHZtUTZreDJkanZaeWFxOEM0N3VtY0Z5Y2tvU0thYWJkLVhMZEE) — Warrior Maven

**Signal**: Russia’s hybrid drone campaign is provoking a nuclear rethink in the Baltics and exposing vulnerabilities in U.S. air defense coverage over Europe, while the U.S. military-industrial base struggles to keep pace with both production and innovation.

中国军情.zh: 南海与台海方向紧张加剧。中国智库报告指出驻菲美军在高端冲突中[十分脆弱](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPa1dEcFppMkI5WEJvanhwVGV2a1RRNVB6NDNGMTRvZGVUX0RkeWdDSVdmV041cTh1NHI1ZldORmduY3Uyc0c4TmpIQlBUdmdQOHotRWtCSmp2d0NjZTRKRjRBSGtxNDhiTG5XNGF1NWRSSnRLUjN1dVQ0R2ZUUHlFVFdFNDFXWGlNckJxQw)，暗示美菲同盟的弱点。日美加快军事勾连，日本陆上自卫队首次派遣部队，中国则出动航母回应。美国外交官公开建议台湾打造[“蜂巢”无人机群](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVEFVX3lxTFBiT0FJaVRPRUtJQVpzMjhLVDNuczJmTjN6WDFOZTU3U1UwektrWGpEQzhPejhvaFlxakpHckwtNTlpQUFXMjR1ZVdTSkp6eWcwS2o1Sw)作为威慑。此外，美方将部分中企列入“中国军事企业清单”，中国商务部回应。值得注意的是，南海热带低压导致琼州海峡停运，但下阶段台风可能影响演习部署。
中国军情.en:
China’s military is rapidly asserting its presence in the Indo-Pacific, with a new 12,000-ton Type 055 destroyer operating off Japan just three months after commissioning. A Chinese think tank report warns that U.S. forces in the Philippines are highly vulnerable in a high-end conflict, while Japan’s first deployment of Ground Self-Defense Force units to the South China Sea drew a Chinese carrier response. Meanwhile, a U.S. diplomat’s call for a Taiwanese drone force and MIT professor’s analysis of Ukraine war lessons for Taiwan reflect the intensifying debate over how to deter a potential Chinese invasion.

- [China’s 12,000-ton destroyer off Japan coast just months after commissioning](https://news.google.) — 19FortyFive
- [Chinese think tank: U.S. forces in Philippines vulnerable in high-end conflict](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPa1dEcFppMkI5WEJvanhwVGV2a1RRNVB6NDNGMTRvZGVUX0RkeWdDSVdmV041cTh1NHI1ZldORmduY3Uyc0c4TmpIQlBUdmdQOHotRWtCSmp2d0NjZTRKRjRBSGtxNDhiTG5XNGF1NWRSSnRLUjN1dVQ0R2ZUUHlFVFdFNDFXWGlNckJxQw) — 搜狐网
- [Japan deploys Ground Force to South China Sea, China responds with carrier](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxPSFpwb2puQkVlQXdvaXViNy1iMzVwTHgtQU5SZXJQdGdzaUdmMjVDaUdfMENlY0FUOTVtZGhZZVZUeE9hY3lfVHoxb3gyWFRFQUZIYmxSbGpqcU1RUzUyeFc3U3ZtRWZJNTA5TnZ3UDNNeEFTWHZkazNBMk5iblp2T2tseGVrSnRyc1E4dllTWl9xazBlWGozbzVhcTBEcU9m) — 朝鮮日報中文版
- [MIT professor: Ukraine war lessons for Taiwan](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWEFVX3lxTE5NWUdQZ09kWWw4Z0hkYWRVZjZYMTMzU2JkaFBqT09rNThJMDZCUGVEbjFkbkY5TVpSc3RIZ1VRUGVsZE1iOTJvRWVBdzllZk1KYlE4Zl8wMFk) — 中美印象

**Signal**: China is operationalizing its naval buildup at an unprecedented pace, and the Philippines-Japan-U.S. axis is facing increased pressure, making the South China Sea a flashpoint for potential miscalculation.

海军与印太.zh: 美国海军陆战队已将“铁穹”防空系统（中程拦截能力系统）部署至冲绳，针对[巡航导弹和无人机威胁](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/02/marines-deploy-iron-dome-air-defense-systems-to-the-western-pacific)，强化西太平洋基地防御。美国防部设立无人系统主管，旨在确保美军无人机主导权；MBDA在Eurosatory 2026展出新一代“主权打击”巡航导弹LCM Mk2，射程更远。北极方向，Bollinger船厂已提前为美国海岸警卫队[第一艘北极巡逻舰切割钢板](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/02/bollinger-quietly-cut-steel-for-first-arctic-security-cutter-in-april-ahead-of-2-2b-award)，合同总额22亿美元。东南亚方面，印尼首艘“天蝎座进化型”潜艇将于本月开始本土建造，显示区域海军现代化提速。
海军与印太.en:
The U.S. Marine Corps has deployed Iron Dome air defense systems to the Western Pacific for the first time, specifically to counter cruise missiles and drones in a potential conflict with China. The Pentagon established a new portfolio manager for unmanned systems to accelerate drone dominance, while MBDA unveiled the LCM Mk2 long-range cruise missile at Eurosatory. In the Arctic, Bollinger cut steel for the first Coast Guard Arctic Security Cutter months ahead of its $2.2 billion contract award, and Indonesia began local construction of Scorpène Evolved submarines.

- [Marines Deploy Iron Dome Air Defense Systems to the Western Pacific](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/02/marines-deploy-iron-dome-air-defense-systems-to-the-western-pacific) — USNI News
- [Defense Department Memo Establishing the Direct Reporting Portfolio Manager for Unmanned Systems](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/02/defense-department-memo-establishing-the-direct-reporting-portfolio-manager-for-unmanned-systems) — USNI News
- [Video: MBDA’s New LCM Mk2 Sovereign Deep Strike Cruise Missile](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/video-mbdas-new-lcm-mk2-sovereign-deep-strike-cruise-missile/) — Naval News
- [Bollinger Quietly Cut Steel for First Arctic Security Cutter in April Ahead of $2.2B Award](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/02/bollinger-quietly-cut-steel-for-first-arctic-security-cutter-in-april-ahead-of-2-2b-award) — USNI News
- [First Local Construction of Scorpène Evolved to Begin This Month in Indonesia](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/first-local-construction-of-scorpene-evolved-to-begin-this-month-in-indonesia/) — Naval News

**Signal**: The U.S. is rapidly adapting to the drone threat in the Pacific with layered defenses and new organizational structures, while allies are accelerating their own naval and strike capabilities—the Indo-Pacific is becoming a proving ground for next-generation warfare concepts.

HackNews社区动态.zh: 社区昨日焦点从基础设施转向隐私与主权。[弗吉尼亚禁止销售地理定位数据](https://www.hunton.com/privacy-and-cybersecurity-law-blog/virginia-bans-sale-of-geolocation-data)以628点高居榜首，[EFF联合盟友反对X公司豁免FTC隐私令](https://www.eff.org/deeplinks/2026/06/eff-and-allies-xs-ftc-petition-waive-privacy-violation-order-should-be-rejected)紧随其后。Scott Aaronson撰文[《美国隐私紧急状态》](https://scottaaronson.blog/?p=9902)引发226个讨论，指出人口普查局禁用噪声注入后隐私风险暴增。另有一篇[瑞士25Gbps宽带对比美国市场失灵](https://stefan.schueller.net/posts/the-free-market-lie/)的文章以74点质疑自由市场叙事。技术层面，[crustc项目将Rust编译器完整翻译为C代码](https://github.com/FractalFir/crustc)获192点，[LMDB 1.0发布](http://www.lmdb.tech/doc/)也值得开发者关注。整体而言，社区情绪在‘技术乐观’与‘制度悲观’之间摇摆，隐私规制正从口号走向立法。
HackNews社区动态.en:
The Hacker News community is deeply engaged with privacy, infrastructure policy, and open-source milestones. The top-voted story—Virginia banning geolocation data sales (628 points)—reflects a growing consensus that state-level action is outpacing federal privacy law. Technical posts like the crustc project (Rust compiler rewritten in C) and the LMDB 1.0 release highlight persistent interest in low-level systems work. Meanwhile, the 'Free Market Lie' critique of US broadband underperformance relative to Switzerland's 25 Gbit internet has sparked a lively policy debate.

- [Virginia bans sale of geolocation data](https://www.hunton.com/privacy-and-cybersecurity-law-blog/virginia-bans-sale-of-geolocation-data) — 628 points, 107 comments: A landmark state law that could set a precedent for other states.
- [crustc: entirety of rustc, translated to C](https://github.com/FractalFir/crustc) — 192 points: A bold project that aims to make Rust's compiler self-hostable in C, raising questions about portability and future toolchain design.
- [Lightning Memory-Mapped Database Manager (LMDB) 1.0](http://www.lmdb.tech/doc/) — 71 points: After years of development, LMDB reaches a stable 1.0 release, critical for high-performance embedded databases.
- [The Free Market Lie: Why Switzerland Has 25 Gbit Internet and America Doesn't](https://stefan.schueller.net/posts/the-free-market-lie/) — 74 points: A data-rich argument against the notion that deregulated markets automatically produce better broadband.
- [An American Privacy Emergency](https://scottaaronson.blog/?p=9902) — 226 points: Scott Aaronson warns that the Census Bureau's ban on noise infusion, combined with data broker sales, creates an emergency of 'perfect surveillance.'

**Signal to watch:** The convergence of privacy laws (Virginia, FTC actions) with grassroots technical resistance (EFF letters, Aaronson's essay) suggests that Q3 will see more corporate pushback and possibly federal preemption debates.

科技产品.zh: 产品端亮点在于游戏物理载体的终结与太空商用化。[Sony奥地利光盘厂已开始转产微透镜](https://www.theverge.com/games/961203/sony-austria-thalgau-end-disc-production-microlenses-instead)证实了光盘时代的落幕，The Verge同步推出播客[《视频游戏光盘已死》](https://www.theverge.com/podcast/960810/video-game-disc-dead-vergecast)。太空领域，[True Anomaly与Rocket Lab为美国太空军执行轨道飞越任务](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/02/private-space-pilots-are-flying-orbital-missions-for-the-us-space-force/)，标志私营企业在军事太空中的角色升级。安全方面，[新型macOS恶意软件PamStealer采用隐蔽手法](https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/07/new-pamstealer-macos-malware-uses-clever-tradecraft-to-remain-stealthy/)，提示Mac平台攻击面扩大。此外，[旅行App Hopper因隐藏费用被FTC罚款3500万美元](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/02/travel-app-hopper-to-pay-35m-in-ftc-settlement-over-unfairly-charging-hidden-fees/)，暗黑模式监管持续收紧。
科技产品.en:
Consumer tech and hardware news today is dominated by the end of an era—Sony's PlayStation disc factory is being retooled for microlenses, underscoring the death of physical media. Security researchers discovered a stealthy macOS infostealer called PamStealer, and travel app Hopper will pay $35M to settle FTC charges over hidden fees. On the space frontier, private pilots are flying orbital missions for the US Space Force, marking a new phase in commercial-military collaboration.

- [Sony's PlayStation disc factory is already being repurposed](https://www.theverge.com/games/961203/sony-austria-thalgau-end-disc-production-microlenses-instead) — The Verge reports that Sony's Thalgau plant, which produced 600,000 discs daily (half for PlayStation), will shift to making microlenses, cementing the disc's obsolescence.
- [Newly discovered PamStealer isn't your typical macOS malware](https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/07/new-pamstealer-macos-malware-uses-clever-tradecraft-to-remain-stealthy/) — Ars Technica details how this infostealer uses clever tradecraft, highlighting a rise in Mac-specific threats.
- [Travel app Hopper to pay $35M in FTC settlement over 'unfairly' charging hidden fees](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/02/travel-app-hopper-to-pay-35m-in-ftc-settlement-over-unfairly-charging-hidden-fees/) — TechCrunch: The FTC crackdown on dark patterns continues; Hopper's settlement includes changes to its booking flow.
- [Private space pilots are flying orbital missions for the US Space Force](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/02/private-space-pilots-are-flying-orbital-missions-for-the-us-space-force/) — TechCrunch: True Anomaly and Rocket Lab are now executing satellite fly-bys for the military, blurring lines between commercial and defense space operations.
- [IQM, Europe's first public quantum company, admits the future of the tech is uncertain](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/02/iqm-europes-first-public-quantum-company-admits-the-future-of-the-tech-is-uncertain/) — IQM went public at a ~$1.9B valuation but acknowledged quantum computing's timeline is unclear, a rare moment of candor.

**Signal to watch:** The shift from physical to digital in gaming (Sony factory repurposing) and the rise of commercial space defense contracts are structural changes that will reshape supply chains and investment flows. The Hopper settlement signals that regulators are serious about algorithmic pricing transparency.

AI.zh: AI行业昨日迎来多重信号转折。[特朗普在宣布AI行动计划同日购入科技股](https://www.engadget.com/2206671/donald-trump-bought-a-bunch-of-tech-stock-the-same-day-he-announced-his-ai-action-plan/)引发道德争议，同时[特朗普批准Anthropic全球化](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwgFBVV95cUxPRUpmOS0wanpsYTMyei1XRXdBTlQzNTlZSTlEdDFORkowVGRQQ2x0RUg2YVBPWEZfM0ZSU0lPNUV4U1pnOWphb0FXTDZyQ3dsU1hjcEJyWVNVZWxlX2REcFVFRzAxUnZOUWJPcEk4cmE4RFdMNWFhMFRyMnlUeFdLTXQ4QkNRRzM0LUtxQmI1Wm9nN2NNZndmcEFxYllXdll4eURVU1BGU2owRHVQcTF3aUxIQmtQV2pYZVpUS2ZJaHR4UQ)，地缘博弈加剧。成本压力显性化：[Tesla对员工AI支出设每周200美元上限](https://electrek.co/2026/07/02/tesla-caps-employee-ai-spending-200-week/)，[Zuckerberg对内承认AI代理进展不及预期](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/02/mark-zuckerberg-tells-staff-that-ai-agents-havent-progressed-as-quickly-as-hed-hoped/)。与此同时，[Google诺贝尔奖得主离开DeepMind加入Anthropic](https://news.google.)，人才流向明星AI公司。供给侧，[Cloudflare将过滤为AI公司服务的爬虫](https://www.engadget.com/2207360/cloudflare-will-filter-out-web-crawlers-that-serve-ai-companies/)，内容所有者反击数据抓取。[Sam Altman呼吁美国主导建立全球AI标准论坛](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxOOGV0U3BzU0lZYS03cGlReGdZU1JmZzlEc1hEeGlDS205NHJVT1ZyQ09la2tXUnE2UTM0QUdaSHZNWlBnRmp1T0s1STFjWUNsejRtOE1HemJsai1JVlR4RnIwMVBsVVdONExqaEdJVy05ZmFZbUhpQ05jbEdMdE90M2p3dDN3T3dMX0JveTZFN1BjSkRkVjk3M3BhdE1ieTNTSzh2bTEtbw)，显示治理竞赛白热化。
AI.en:
The AI sector is wrestling with cost overruns and slowed expectations. Tesla caps employee AI spending at $200/week, Zuckerberg admits agents aren't progressing fast enough, and a TechCrunch analysis reveals AI is sabotaging Big Tech's net-zero goals. Meanwhile, Meta launched Pocket, a 'vibe-coded' game-making app, and Anthropic is discussing a custom chip with Samsung—signs that the battle for AI infrastructure is intensifying. Trump's stock purchases in tech on the day of his AI Action Plan raise ethics questions.

- [Tesla caps employee AI spending at $200/week except for Grok](https://electrek.co/2026/07/02/tesla-caps-employee-ai-spending-200-week/) — Electrek: An internal memo reveals strict limits on AI tool usage, likely to curb costs amid the company's own AI investments.
- [Mark Zuckerberg tells staff that AI agents haven't progressed as quickly as he'd hoped](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/02/mark-zuckerberg-tells-staff-that-ai-agents-havent-progressed-as-quickly-as-hed-hoped/) — TechCrunch: Internal meeting sentiment suggests Meta is recalibrating its AI roadmap.
- [A warning sign about AI's real cost, courtesy of Google and Amazon](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/02/a-warning-sign-about-ais-real-cost-courtesy-of-google-and-amazon/) — TechCrunch: AI's energy and hardware demands are pushing net-zero pledges further out of reach.
- [Meta quietly launches vibe-coded gaming app Pocket](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/02/meta-quietly-launches-vibe-coded-gaming-app-pocket/) — TechCrunch: Pocket lets users create and share mini games via text prompts, but is currently unavailable in the US.
- [Anthropic is discussing a new custom chip with Samsung](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/02/anthropic-is-discussing-a-new-custom-chip-with-samsung/) — TechCrunch: Following OpenAI's Broadcom partnership, Anthropic seeks its own silicon to reduce reliance on Nvidia.

**Signal to watch:** The tension between AI ambition and financial/environmental costs is becoming a boardroom issue. If Tesla and Meta are tightening belts, expect more companies to follow. The custom chip race (OpenAI/Broadcom, Anthropic/Samsung) will accelerate, potentially fragmenting the AI hardware market.

汽车.zh: 电动车市场昨日出现多重分化信号。[特斯拉Q2交付量同比增长25%](https://www.theverge.com/transportation/957685/tesla-q2-2026-sales-production-delivery-report)，Model Y L（6座长轴版）在美上市，起价61,990美元。[比亚迪澳洲销量创纪录，Sealion 7逼近丰田HiLux](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxQWVUzQlI1dG9zVWYta29fLXpHbWlaamlpbjZQc3dZTUVhbm5JSWJzTDRJWWZDbGJDZERNWk5QS0NsLVE3akFiT2lNV1JpbW03Q0JTSmlnMkZIYVJ3QVNKb0hDLTRLMTRtclVXbm93WVBhZE1UZE9EQ000Y05nTnFZWUt3cTBtdkg4Mlh4YUU5RGJGQzhxbjJRTzZFR3lGdk5PeWxzMnB6Qk9Ec1RkR1QxcA)。但政策风险抬头：[Polestar因被美商务部禁售而降价2.5万美元](https://electrek.co/2026/07/02/polestar-4s-are-a-smoking-deal-at-25k-off-now-that-theyre-banned-in-the-us/)，[特斯拉FSD事故致司机面临过失杀人指控](https://www.theverge.com/transportation/961161/tesla-fsd-katy-tx-manslaughter-charges)。技术路线方面，[中石化旗下杂志承认氢能重卡已‘死亡’](https://electrek.co/2026/07/02/hydrogen-for-heavy-trucks-is-dead-says-worlds-2nd-largest-oil-company/)，电池电动重卡胜出。丰田方面，[因取消旗舰EV向供应商支付‘空前’赔偿](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxNWXBoOWFPZ3RRUjA3ZlpWTFhLSXhpVC1lMC1FNEZJTEFfRW9WbEdNMjgtMHJtNFpWVjRaYXVjanlibTNrSHE0R19UZllYS3pKaWdxaURvVTZ4dWxTZm5pbzFaTGJQanpOTHZBNHJxWXN5NlkwWFRraVRWeEdPME9wR3o5WlpVNWE4Z0h3WGpMcWR0NXd6RDY0Yg)，[Subaru Trailseeker EV以低于4万美元起售](https://electrek.co/2026/07/02/subarus-375-hp-awd-trailseeker-ev-starts-under-40000/)则显示平价车型竞争加剧。
汽车.en:
The EV market is in flux: Tesla's global Q2 sales jumped 25% but a fatal FSD crash in Texas led to manslaughter charges, casting a shadow over autonomous driving claims. BYD and Tesla both posted record June sales in Australia, while BYD's Sealion 7 nearly dethroned the Toyota HiLux. Polestar's US ban triggered massive discounts, and Subaru launched an affordable 375-hp Trailseeker EV. On the battery front, Iberdrola started its first US large-scale storage project and the world's largest second-life EV battery factory opened in six weeks.

- [Tesla driver faces manslaughter charges over Texas crash that killed a woman inside her home](https://www.theverge.com/transportation/961161/tesla-fsd-katy-tx-manslaughter-charges) — The Verge: The driver claimed FSD was engaged; this is the first such criminal case and could set legal precedent for autonomous driving liability.
- [Tesla launches Model Y L in US — 6 seats, 325 miles, $61,990](https://electrek.co/2026/07/02/tesla-model-y-l-us-launch-61990/) — Electrek: A stretched 6-seat variant expands Tesla's family SUV offerings, priced above competitors.
- [BYD Sealion 7 nearly topples Toyota HiLux in record month](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxQWVUzQlI1dG9zVWYta29fLXpHbWlaamlpbjZQc3dZTUVhbm5JSWJzTDRJWWZDbGJDZERNWk5QS0NsLVE3akFiT2lNV1JpbW03Q0JTSmlnMkZIYVJ3QVNKb0hDLTRLMTRtclVXbm93WVBhZE1UZE9EQ000Y05nTnFZWUt3cTBtdkg4Mlh4YUU5RGJGQzhxbjJRTzZFR3lGdk5PeWxzMnB6Qk9Ec1RkR1QxcA) — Carsales: BYD's aggressive pricing and range are challenging traditional market leaders in Australia.
- [Polestar EVs are a smoking deal at $25k off now that they're banned in the US](https://electrek.co/2026/07/02/polestar-4s-are-a-smoking-deal-at-25k-off-now-that-theyre-banned-in-the-us/) — Electrek: The Commerce Department ban triggers fire sales, making Polestar 4 nearly the cheapest EV in America despite the import restrictions.
- [Hydrogen for heavy trucks is dead, says world's 2nd-largest oil company](https://electrek.co/2026/07/02/hydrogen-for-heavy-trucks-is-dead-says-worlds-2nd-largest-oil-company/) — Electrek: Sinopec's admission signals a major inflection point, with batteries now beating hydrogen on cost and infrastructure.

**Signal to watch:** The Tesla FSD manslaughter case could spur regulatory action on autonomous driving claims, while the Polestar ban and BYD's rise underscore how geopolitical trade policy is reshaping EV competition. The 'hydrogen is dead' declaration from a major oil company may accelerate battery-electric trucking investment.

足球.zh:
世界杯16强争夺战高潮迭起，VAR成为葡萄牙vs克罗地亚之战的绝对主角——克罗地亚补时绝平被吹，C罗继续前进而莫德里奇告别。西班牙3-0轻取奥地利，奥亚萨瓦尔低调闪光。英格兰则在为面对墨西哥的恐怖主场做精密准备。

- [VAR争议改写结局，葡萄牙2-1力克克罗地亚](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cz0jee3vy39o) — 格瓦迪奥尔第91分钟进球被判越位，葡萄牙逃过一劫，C罗助攻拉莫斯后亲手杀死比赛，16强将战西班牙。
- [西班牙3-0胜奥地利，奥亚萨瓦尔成隐形英雄](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cvgd0jz1xq7o) — 这位皇家社会队长用跑动和串联诠释无锋战术，西班牙渐入佳境。
- [英格兰秘密备战对抗墨西哥噪音](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c74y7jwj30eo) — 三狮军团在墨西哥当地安排秘密地点，使用睡眠设备确保球员不受外部干扰，细节见真章。

收束判断：葡萄牙vs西班牙的伊比利亚德比将决定谁能走得更远；英格兰若跨过墨西哥，四分之一决赛前景将更明朗。
足球.en:
The football desk is dominated by World Cup round-of-16 action, with Portugal's controversial win over Croatia, Spain's comfortable victory, and England's off-field preparations. Also notable are updates from Wimbledon and Formula 1, as the '足球' desk aggregates broader sports news from BBC and Sky.

- **Portugal 2-1 Croatia** – Cristiano Ronaldo scored and a late VAR offside call denied Croatia an equalizer. Portugal will face Spain in the last 16. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cz0jee3vy39o) | [Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/football/portugal-vs-croatia/report/549850)
- **Spain 3-0 Austria** – A dominant display with Mikel Oyarzabal as the standout performer. They advance to face a yet-unknown opponent. [Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/football/spain-vs-austria/report/549849)
- **England's Mexico preparation** – Secret locations and sleep devices used to counter loud Mexican fans. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c74y7jwj30eo)
- **Tennis: Arthur Fery last Brit at Wimbledon** – The French-born player carries British hopes after three others exited. [Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/tennis/news/12040/13559889/wimbledon-arthur-fery-becomes-last-british-player-standing-as-katie-swan-jacob-fearnley-and-jan-choinski-bow-out)
- **F1: Hamilton and Antonelli on title race** – Hamilton vows to win eighth title; Antonelli insists he still has momentum at Mercedes. [Sky Sports: Hamilton](https://www.skysports.com/f1/news/12040/13559728/lewis-hamilton-ferrari-driver-wont-stop-in-formula-1-until-he-wins-record-eighth-world-title) | [Sky Sports: Antonelli](https://www.skysports.com/f1/news/12040/13559726/kimi-antonelli-mercedes-driver-says-he-still-has-championship-momentum-against-george-russell-ahead-of-british-gp)

Portugal vs Spain and England vs Mexico will be the headline fixtures this weekend, with high stakes for all teams.

羽毛球.zh:

- [孙俪元亚青赛退赛](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9PYkFSRW9FdGd1ekVTZTRlU3VNOFdObUdzQXlEMXRabGdMR0NtQURLRVlla0Q5ckhva3plNlV1RTZ2TmdnQllfMjNYZVZVSEVjOW50bDZOS0ZVdkFlRWVQ1g2UQ) — 这位年轻选手的伤退让国羽女单后备力量再遇考验，具体伤情和康复时间尚待官方说明。
- [深圳杯业余羽毛球联赛收官](https://news.google.) — 基层赛事持续活跃，为羽毛球大众参与提供平台。

收束判断：孙俪元的健康是国羽年轻化的关键变量，其恢复进度将影响未来世青赛及国际赛事排兵布阵。

收束判断：郭昊文夏联表现将直接决定其未来职业生涯走向，中国球员留洋窗口能否再次打开，此役至关重要。
篮球.en:
Chinese basketball player Guo Haowen has relinquished a lucrative CBA contract to become the only Chinese player participating in the NBA Summer League this summer. Meanwhile, CCTV5 programming includes NBA and CBA broadcasts.

- **Guo Haowen to NBA Summer League** – The guard turned down a high-paying CBA deal to try out for an NBA roster, making him the sole Chinese representative in this year's Summer League. [搜狐](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPQy1ENEtUT1FPeGRxcEI0YWZacUlLT0VqdGM1OFJCOEswb2ZyMzM3SVJvbjVSYWdvSkJ4dWY2aDdkSW1hR0VxUHpsOVp5TFVnTHQ0UzFnWE1lMk1uQkg5aVlJdzVFSmVmbUItQXpsYm5yQVZ3Y2x5aGlCSWloX0pzalVXYVRHNy12Q2huRA)
- **CCTV5 schedule includes NBA and CBA** – The broadcaster is set to air NBA Summer League games alongside Chinese Basketball Association matches, reflecting continued interest. [Sina Sports](https://news.google.)

Guo Haowen's NBA Summer League stint could be a stepping stone to a contract; fans should watch for his performance in Las Vegas.
